# Smart Form Filler - Project Board

## 🎯 Project Overview

Smart Form Filler is evolving through a carefully planned roadmap with four major milestones, each building upon the previous to create a comprehensive form automation platform.

## 📋 GitHub Project Board Structure

### 🏷️ Labels

- **Epic Labels**: `epic` - Major feature tracking
- **Version Labels**: `v3.0.0`, `v4.0.0`, `v5.0.0`, `v6.0.0` - Version-specific features
- **Priority Labels**: `high-priority`, `medium-priority`, `low-priority`
- **Type Labels**: `enhancement`, `bug`, `documentation`, `task`
- **Status Labels**: `in-progress`, `needs-review`, `blocked`

### 📊 Project Columns

1. **📋 Backlog** - All planned features and tasks
2. **🎯 Next Up** - Items ready for development
3. **🚧 In Progress** - Currently being worked on
4. **👀 Review** - Completed and awaiting review
5. **✅ Done** - Completed and merged

## 🗺️ Roadmap Milestones

### Milestone 1: Cloud-First Architecture (v3.0.0)
**Target:** Q3 2025 | **Epic:** [#1](https://github.com/hddevteam/smart-form-filler/issues/1)

Transform into pure frontend application with direct cloud API integration.

**Key Features:**
- Remove Node.js backend dependency
- Direct cloud API integration (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini)
- Secure credential management
- Enhanced performance optimization

**Success Metrics:**
- 50% reduction in setup complexity
- 40% faster data processing
- Zero backend infrastructure requirements

### Milestone 2: Document Processing Engine (v4.0.0)
**Target:** Q4 2025 | **Epic:** [#2](https://github.com/hddevteam/smart-form-filler/issues/2)

Enable processing of Word, Excel, and PDF documents as data sources.

**Key Features:**
- Multi-format document support (.docx, .xlsx, .pdf)
- Intelligent data extraction
- Document management system
- Smart form mapping

**Success Metrics:**
- Support for 10+ document formats
- >95% data extraction accuracy
- 200% increase in data source variety

### Milestone 3: Visual Intelligence (v5.0.0)
**Target:** Q1 2026 | **Epic:** [#3](https://github.com/hddevteam/smart-form-filler/issues/3)

Integrate OCR and computer vision for image-based data extraction.

**Key Features:**
- OCR text extraction (95%+ accuracy)
- Multi-language support
- Specialized extractors (receipts, business cards)
- Camera and screenshot integration

**Success Metrics:**
- 95%+ OCR accuracy for printed text
- 10+ language support
- 150% improvement in data extraction accuracy

### Milestone 4: Advanced Data Management (v6.0.0)
**Target:** Q2 2026 | **Epic:** [#4](https://github.com/hddevteam/smart-form-filler/issues/4)

Comprehensive data control with editing, validation, and workflows.

**Key Features:**
- Advanced data editor interface
- Comprehensive validation system
- Data version control
- Smart suggestions and learning

**Success Metrics:**
- 90% reduction in data entry errors
- Support 100+ validation rules
- 80% increase in user data control satisfaction

## 🔄 Development Workflow

### Issue Lifecycle

1. **Planning Phase**
   - Epic created with milestone goals
   - Break down into development tasks
   - Assign priority and effort estimates

2. **Development Phase**
   - Move tasks to "Next Up" when ready
   - Assign to developers
   - Move to "In Progress" when work begins

3. **Review Phase**
   - Create pull request when complete
   - Move to "Review" column
   - Code review and testing

4. **Completion Phase**
   - Merge approved changes
   - Move to "Done" column
   - Update epic progress

### Branch Strategy

- `main` - Production ready code
- `develop` - Integration branch
- `feature/milestone-X-feature-name` - Feature branches
- `hotfix/issue-description` - Emergency fixes

## 📈 Progress Tracking

### Current Status (July 2025)
- **v2.0.0**: ✅ Complete (Current stable version)
- **v3.0.0**: 📋 Planning phase - Epic and initial tasks created
- **v4.0.0**: 📋 Planning phase - Epic created
- **v5.0.0**: 📋 Planning phase - Epic created
- **v6.0.0**: 📋 Planning phase - Epic created

### Key Performance Indicators

- **Issue Velocity**: Number of issues completed per sprint
- **Epic Progress**: Percentage completion of each milestone
- **Code Quality**: Test coverage and review approval rate
- **User Feedback**: Beta testing satisfaction scores

## 🎯 Sprint Planning

### Sprint Duration: 2 weeks

### Sprint Goals Template
```markdown
## Sprint X Goals

**Milestone Focus:** vX.X.X - Milestone Name

**Sprint Objectives:**
- [ ] Objective 1
- [ ] Objective 2
- [ ] Objective 3

**Issues Planned:**
- [ ] #XX - Issue Title
- [ ] #XX - Issue Title

**Definition of Done:**
- All acceptance criteria met
- Code reviewed and approved
- Tests passing
- Documentation updated
```
